name: hoc/auth-form
description: A unified authentication-form HOC that supports login, registration, and password-reset flows across password, phone OTP, email OTP, and OAuth methods. Includes configurable OTP inline/step modes, provider actions, mode/method switching, validation hooks, and async submission orchestration in a single composable card layout.
useCases: Product authentication pages that need password and OTP fallback in one component
SaaS onboarding where users can switch between register and login without route jumps
Security-first reset flows requiring OTP verification and new-password confirmation
Internationalized auth screens with configurable methods and provider-specific OAuth entry points
usage: import { AuthForm, type AuthFormProps, type AdvancedAuthMode, type AdvancedAuthMethod, type AdvancedAuthOtpFlow, type AdvancedAuthProvider, type AdvancedAuthValidationResult, type AdvancedAuthSubmitPayload } from "shadcn-solid-components/hoc/auth-form"
